create_ObservationCropper: create an ObservationCropper instance to crop game observations to a subwindow
build_FixedCropper: build a FixedCropper that extracts a fixed rectangular subwindow from pycolab observations
create_ScrollingCropper: create a ScrollingCropper that pans a scrolling window to track moving game entities
test_crop_method: test the crop method on ObservationCropper subclasses to produce cropped observations
review_set_engine: review the set_engine method to connect an ObservationCropper to a pycolab game engine
